description: Each dot-separated group is compared as a number, so `1.10` is above `1.2` — which a string comparison gets backwards. A missing group counts as zero, which makes `"2"` and `"2.0"` equal.
Both arguments must satisfy `isValidVersion`: digits and dots only, no pre-release suffix.
returns: `-1` when the first is lower, `0` when they are equal, `1` when the first is higher.

throws.TypeError: either argument is not a valid version string.
